initialSheet: Use case: stylized-concept. Production reference sheet for Together Anyways. Reference image is the authoritative ship identity, not composition. Show THREE large clearly separated views of exactly this same compact worn ivory-and-teal utility spacecraft: upper left rear starboard three-quarter grounded showing twin rear drive exhausts and same single starboard entry hatch; upper right low front port three-quarter airborne with underside exposed; lower wide pure port side profile. Neutral pale warm gray studio backdrop, realistic detailed illustration matching reference. Preserve blunt faceted glazed cockpit, two seats, short broad fuselage, paired bulky aft dorsal cylindrical drives, short thick side lift sponsons with downward thrusters, patched panels, copper plumbing, weathering, landing feet. No wings, rotors, added engines, duplicate doors or elongated fuselage. Airborne view feet folded close underneath, hatch closed; grounded views feet deployed. Newly visible rear and underside are restrained extrapolations of existing hardware. Entire silhouette visible in each view, no people, no text, no decorative borders. High resolution landscape sheet.
rear: Use case: stylized-concept. Single full-frame rear three-quarter reference of the EXACT ship in the input. Camera behind ship at rear-starboard, nose recedes toward upper right, we see stern and starboard flank. Preserve compact broad ivory/teal weathered hull, faceted cockpit, short lift sponsons, landing feet and ONE starboard door. Exactly TWO main cylindrical engines total, arranged SIDE BY SIDE at the upper aft left and upper aft right at the SAME HEIGHT. Show their two rear circular exhaust mouths. NO vertically stacked engines and NO third engine. Distinct small downward lift nozzles under short side sponsons retained. Do not redesign or elongate craft. Plain pale warm gray studio ground, soft illumination, detailed realistic illustrated material treatment matching reference. Entire ship uncropped. No text, people, panels or montage.
reverseCockpit: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE reverse camera angle of the same compact ship interior reference. Camera just inside front windshield aimed AFT toward the TWO empty pilot seats so we see seat fronts, not backs; a low dashboard edge in foreground. Seats side by side same battered brown upholstery metal frames. Behind seats a SHORT cramped cabin ending in solid aft bulkhead with exposed plumbing. Since looking aft, single STARBOARD open entry door must be on IMAGE LEFT behind seats, PORT low teal service cabinet on IMAGE RIGHT behind seats. No aft window or second cockpit. Ivory and teal scratched hull, copper pipes, gridded floor, thick frames, same realistic detailed illustrated style. Neutral modest work lighting for readable geometry; this is layout reference not grounded-story lighting. No characters, no text. Landscape.
underside: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE low front three-quarter view from beneath the exact referenced spacecraft hovering, entire underside and silhouette visible against pale gray studio background. Same short broad battered ivory-and-teal utility craft, blunt faceted cockpit, two upper aft main engines side by side, two short thick lateral lift sponsons with small downward nozzles, copper plumbing and patched belly plates. Closed single starboard hatch. Landing legs folded close to belly with feet visibly retained, not removed. This is a restrained underside reference extrapolation, not a new craft. No added engines, wings, rotors, fins, weapons or people. Detailed realistic illustrated style and weathering matched to reference. Landscape single image, no text.
